verdict.rationale: Docusign has a REST/eSign API for sending and routing envelopes for signature (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-13) and ships an official MCP server (docusign-probe-3) documented in a Claude connector guide that can retrieve agreement context/metadata and trigger workflow actions (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12). Separate AI-Assisted Review/CLM features can draft and flag clause language (docusign-docs-16, docusign-docs-20, docusign-docs-25), but there's no evidence these drafting capabilities are exposed through the same API/MCP surface to let an agent draft an NDA and then autonomously route it end-to-end in one flow, and community reports flag real integration friction (docusign-comm-1, docusign-comm-3) alongside positive experiences (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5). Missing for 10: a documented single API/MCP workflow that both generates NDA content and completes signature routing, and independent confirmation of that end-to-end agentic flow working in practice.
